transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for the last 11 months. I just feel constantly down, and it feels like I can't shake this heavy mood at all.
Have you experienced any periods of feeling completely normal or symptom-free during these past 11 months, or has this low mood been present nearly every single day?

No, I haven't had any normal or symptom-free days at all. This low mood has been present nearly every single day for the last 11 months. It just feels like a continuous, heavy cloud that hasn't lifted at all.
During these past 11 months, have you also been experiencing other symptoms like changes in your appetite, sleep patterns, energy levels, or difficulty concentrating?

My sleep has been awful; I struggle to fall asleep, wake up constantly throughout the night, and always wake up too early feeling completely unrefreshed. As for my appetite and concentration, I haven't really noticed any major changes there.
Have you experienced a persistent loss of interest or pleasure in almost all of your usual activities, or are you still able to enjoy things when you participate in them?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in my usual hobbies and activities, and I just don't care about them anymore. Even when I try to force myself to participate, I don't feel any happiness or pleasure from them at all.

Have you ever experienced a period of at least two weeks where your symptoms were significantly more severe, perhaps including feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or thoughts that life is not worth living?

No, I haven't really felt worthless, guilty, or had thoughts that life isn't worth living. However, those general feelings of sadness and emptiness have been consistently there with me for the last 11 months.
Looking back further than the last 11 months, have you ever experienced a period of two years or more where you felt this same persistent low mood?
No, I haven't ever experienced a low mood that lasted for two years or more in the past. My current symptoms only started about 11 months ago, and I felt fine before that.

Since you've been feeling this way for 11 months, have you experienced any other physical or mental symptoms during this time, such as significant fatigue, feelings of indecisiveness, or changes in your energy levels?

I haven't really noticed any indecisiveness, but I have experienced a profound loss of motivation and interest in absolutely everything. My sleep has also been highly disrupted, as I struggle to fall asleep, wake up frequently from nightmares, and feel completely unrefreshed.
Has this loss of motivation and the sleep disruption caused you significant distress or difficulty in your daily functioning, such as at work, school, or in your social relationships?

Yes, it has caused me a lot of distress and made daily life really difficult. Because of my lack of motivation, I struggle to get any work or daily tasks done, and I've also been pulling away from my friends and social relationships. This entire struggle has been going on for about 11 months now.
